channel.title: Open Calls for Artists — Monographica
channel.description: Curated list of open calls for photographers and visual artists. Exhibitions, grants, residencies, and publications worldwide.

item.title: Les Mots du Phare Vol. 04: Futur(s) · Linea Recta Books
item.description: Open call for black-and-white photography for Vol. 04 of Les Mots du Phare, a print publication by Linea Recta Books and Le Phare Collectif. Theme: Futur(s) — imagining what seems impossible, a tomorrow, an after, a continuation. Not the end of the world, but the courage to imagine what is possible. Selected images will be featured in the printed edition alongside text contributions from members of the collective. Submit up to 4 B&W photos combined into one PDF via email. — Deadline: April 26, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Publication.

item.title: Analog Forever Magazine — Calls for Entry
item.description: High-quality print magazine (150+ pages, 8×10") dedicated to film and analog process photography, published roughly annually. Also runs themed online group exhibitions curated by guest curators about four times a year. Check their calls-for-entry page for current open submissions. — Deadline: Continuous. Fee: Varies by call. Prize: Publication.

item.title: Defiance Zine Open Call · Revoke Collective
item.description: Open call for Revoke Collective's first zine on the theme of Defiance. Looking for photographs that challenge, disrupt, or simply refuse. Defiance can take many forms: quiet resistance, bold rebellion, personal freedom, cultural pushback, or moments of quiet nonconformity. Not chasing polish — chasing pulse. Raw vision and unfiltered moments. — Deadline: April 6, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Publication.

item.title: Night Aesthetics · Fotografiska
item.description: Open call exploring the visual world of the night. Looking for works that engage with light, movement, atmosphere, intimacy, and the energy that appears when the day lets go. Whether captured on a crowded dance floor, in a quiet street, or somewhere in between. Welcomes lens-based photography in all forms including analog and digital. Three winners each receive €2,500 and feature on the Fotografiska Emerging platform. In partnership with Jägermeister. — Deadline: April 30, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: €2,500.

item.title: X ROID Bonn 2026 · The Stage Gallery
item.description: 7th edition of the international instant art expo dedicated to Polaroid and Fuji Instax photography. Three-day juried exhibition at The Stage Gallery in Bonn featuring artist talks, a Pola walk, and creative exchanges. Only original instant photographs accepted — no prints. Fee includes professional framing. Gallery takes 25% commission on sales. In media partnership with Analog Forever. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: €225. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: The 2026 Lumen Prize
item.description: Leading international award for art created with technology, now in its 15th year. Three categories: Legacy Futures, Systems & Structures, and Experiential Innovation, each with a $5,000 prize. The Jury also selects one Gold Award Winner receiving $15,000. Works may include film, photography, AI-generated art, interactive installations, VR experiences, and more. Finalists announced August, winners announced November. Awards ceremony at Kunstsilo Museum in Norway. — Deadline: May 23, 2026. Fee: $45. Prize: $30,000.

item.title: Nest — Group Exhibition · Fringe Arts Bath
item.description: Group exhibition exploring how creative practice nurtures wellbeing, inspires reflection, or aids recovery. Open call for art created in response to lived experience of mental health, disability, or health journey. All mediums welcome including photography, painting, film, sculpture, ceramics, poetry, and installation. Curated by photographic artist Livvy Eden. Exhibition runs 22 May – 6 June 2026 at 103 Walcot Street, Bath. Selected artists asked for £25 participation donation. — Deadline: April 10, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Michael P. Smith Fund for Documentary Photography 2025 · New Orleans Photo Alliance
item.description: Annual grant honoring legendary New Orleans documentary photographer Michael P. Smith. Awards cash prizes and exhibition opportunities to Gulf Coast photographers whose work combines artistic excellence and a sustained commitment to a cultural documentary project. Open to photographers residing in Gulf Coast states: Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia, and Florida. Subject matter not limited to Gulf Coast region. — Deadline: May 4, 2026. Fee: $25. Prize: $3,000 + exhibition.

item.title: Monograph No. 01 · No-Type Magazine
item.description: Open call for lens-based artists to submit a cohesive photographic project for an individual artist monograph. The selected artist receives full publication support including editing, design, printing, and marketing, plus 20% of the edition. A shortlist of 6 artists will also receive published interviews. — Deadline: May 31, 2026. Fee: $20. Prize: Publication.

item.title: 37th Annual Juried Photography Show · State of the Art Gallery
item.description: Annual juried photography show in Ithaca, NY. Up to $1,000 in prizes awarded. Original work not previously exhibited at the gallery is accepted across all photographic media. Selected work exhibited May 28 through June 27, 2026. — Deadline: May 1, 2026. Fee: $35. Prize: $1,000.

item.title: Homo Technologicus · LoosenArt
item.description: International call exploring the relationship between humans and technology. Seeking works investigating social, environmental, physical, cognitive, and emotional transformations brought by digital innovation. Group exhibition in Rome, November 2026. — Deadline: July 22, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Residency Program 2026 · Aurora PhotoCenter
item.description: Two residencies for artists working in photography or photo-based media. Each provides a two-week intensive work period, $1,000 stipend, and housing in Indianapolis. Includes darkroom, studio, and digital lab access. Residencies run August through November 2026. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: $1,000 + residency.

item.title: People 2026 · Grid Photo Gallery
item.description: International photography call exploring the human figure across all approaches including portraits, documentary, street photography, and studio work. Diverse interpretations welcome whether posed or unposed, observed or imagined. Selected work displayed in online exhibition. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: €7 per image. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Nature 2026 · Glasgow Gallery of Photography
item.description: Exhibition exploring how we interact with nature. Seeking images that reveal beauty, power, cruelty, and influence on daily life. Selected work displayed in Glasgow gallery, online gallery, and exhibition catalogue. Exhibition runs July 3-31, 2026. — Deadline: March 27, 2026. Fee: Free (£48 if selected). Prize: Exhibition + publication.

item.title: Future Days 2026 · Glasgow Gallery of Photography
item.description: Open theme exhibition asking photographers to represent their vision of the future, whether hopeful or fearful. Interpret the theme at a global, local, or personal level. Selected work displayed in Glasgow gallery, online gallery, and exhibition catalogue. Exhibition runs July 3-31, 2026. — Deadline: March 27, 2026. Fee: Free (£48 if selected). Prize: Exhibition + publication.

item.title: Artist in Residence Program 2026 · TILT Institute
item.description: Four-week residency for artists advancing contemporary photography. Two artists selected: one slot for a Philadelphia-based artist, one open to all. Includes $3,000 honorarium, waived printer/scanner fees, $1,000 ink and paper credit, and $1,500 travel/housing reimbursement. Residencies run June through November 2026. — Deadline: March 29, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: $3,000 + residency.

item.title: Outside the Box: Cameraless Photography · PhotoSynthesis
item.description: Exhibition seeking photographic works incorporating cameraless techniques including photograms, chemigrams, lumen prints, and composites blending camera and non-camera methods. 30-40 pieces selected for gallery exhibition and website display. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: $30. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: SVĚTOVA 1 Artist Residency 2026
item.description: One-month creative residency for an emerging visual artist in Prague. Includes private bedroom, shared 30m² studio in the gallery, production budget of approximately €820, round-trip travel, curatorial support, and opportunities for a public workshop, artist lecture, and exhibition. Open to residents of 39 European countries plus Tunisia. Must not be enrolled in educational programs during the residency. Residency runs November 1 – December 6, 2026. — Deadline: March 23, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: €820 + residency.

item.title: Love & Romance Show · Blue Sky Gallery
item.description: Online exhibition exploring how love has transformed alongside cultural and societal changes, and how those shifts shape personal experience today. Submit up to 3 images connecting the theme of love and romance. Virtual exhibition launches May 7, 2026. — Deadline: April 17, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: EDITION 502 — Open Call for Photo Edition
item.description: Open call for an independent 6×9 photo edition of 12 small photographs. EDITION 502 covers all design, production, and distribution costs. Author receives a percentage of sales. Looking for authors with a clear visual language and comprehensible concept, regardless of education or professional background. Submit 12 photographs with serial character, a cover sheet, and a text (max 2,400 characters). — Deadline: April 30, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Publication.

item.title: Atlas of Ruins Vol.3 — Call for Photos · Reuse Italy
item.description: Submit photographs of architectural ruins from anywhere in the world for the third edition of the Atlas of Ruins book. Photos can depict ruins from any historical period — abandoned buildings, crumbling monuments, forgotten infrastructure. Three registration tiers: Early (until Apr 16, €10/1 photo, €20/up to 10), Regular (until Jul 9, €13/€25), Late (until Oct 1, €16/€30). Fees exclude VAT. All participants receive an ebook copy. Best photos from each country featured in the printed book. — Deadline: October 1, 2026. Fee: €10–€30. Prize: €1,200.

item.title: Texture of Light · Pro Photo DC
item.description: Photography exhibition exploring light as a tactile, physical medium. Submit images where light feels like a material — surface tension on objects, atmospheric mass in fog or dust, architecture of shadow, or abstract luminescence through long exposures and macro work. Selected images will be printed and displayed matted and framed at Western Market in Washington, DC. Exhibition opens May 2, 2026. — Deadline: April 1, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Wider Skies Magazine — Issue 1
item.description: New photo magazine exploring speculative futurism — not as science fiction, but as a way of noticing the near futures already forming around us. Submit up to 4 film photographs for the first issue. Looking for images that point to possible futures grounded in real life — moments of care, repair, survival, shared responsibility, quiet adaptation, or small signs of change. Film only. Free Kodak Pro 100 film available for those who need it. — Deadline: April 10, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Solo Exhibition May 2026 · All About Photo
item.description: Monthly featured photographer showcase. Winner receives a full month online solo exhibition (May 1–31, 2026), permanent gallery presence, exclusive interview, social media promotion, newsletter feature, international press coverage, and commission-free sales. Submit a cohesive project or portfolio of 6–14 images. — Deadline: April 21, 2026. Fee: $45. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: SIYU Award 2026
item.description: Award for young Swiss photographers (formerly vfg Young Talent Award). Ten finalists exhibited in a group show at Photobastei Zurich with a published catalogue. Three cash prizes awarded through the Alois Ottiger Grant, in memory of Swiss photographer Alois Ottiger (1941–2025). Free theme, all fields of photography. Submissions must be anonymous. — Deadline: April 30, 2026. Fee: CHF 50. Prize: CHF 5,000.

item.title: Alpine Fellowship Visual Art Prize 2026
item.description: Annual visual art prize on the theme of JOY. Open to all visual art media including photography, painting, sculpture, video, and installation. One piece per entry, multiple entries allowed as separate submissions. Work must be entirely created without AI. — Deadline: May 1, 2026. Fee: £10. Prize: £3,000.

item.title: This Is a Person · Decagon Gallery
item.description: Portrait photography exploring interior life over surface identity. Seeking images that suggest psychological tension, ambiguity, vulnerability, or contradiction rather than likeness alone. Intentionally selective — approximately 10–12% acceptance rate. One image per selected artist exhibited. — Deadline: May 31, 2026. Fee: $25. Prize: $500.

item.title: Monochrome Awards 2026
item.description: International black and white photography competition with professional and amateur divisions across 14 categories including Abstract, Architecture, Fine Art, Landscapes, Nature, Portrait, Street, and Wildlife. Winners published in annual book and featured in online Winners Gallery. — Deadline: November 15, 2026. Fee: $22–$27. Prize: $3,000.

item.title: Annual Photography Awards 2026
item.description: International photography competition (8th edition) celebrating photographers of all levels. Five main categories — Architecture, Fine Art, Nature, People, and Special — with 25 subcategories. Accepts all formats, looking for bold and innovative approaches. — Deadline: December 13, 2026. Fee: $25–$40. Prize: $2,500.

item.title: HER.SELF · Art Fluent
item.description: Online juried exhibit celebrating women in all their complexities — presence, resilience, beauty, and becoming. Open to all fine art mediums including photography. Artists receive 100% of sale price with no commission. — Deadline: July 17, 2026. Fee: $25. Prize: $1,250.

item.title: Anja Niedringhaus Courage in Photojournalism Award 2026 · International Women's Media Foundation
item.description: Award honoring courageous, high-impact photojournalism by women, nonbinary, and gender-diverse creatives. Submit 12 photographs (6 from 2024–2026, 6 from broader career) plus a 500-word statement. Open to women, nonbinary, and gender non-conforming photojournalists working full-time in journalism. Self-nomination or third-party nomination accepted. Named after Pulitzer Prize-winning photographer Anja Niedringhaus (1965–2014). — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: $20,000.

item.title: LT5 Alternative Photography Show · KALEID Gallery
item.description: Open call for photographers working in alternative photography — including toy and plastic cameras, Polaroid, pinhole, photograms, and other alternative processes. Submit up to 2 works for exhibition at KALEID Gallery in San Jose, CA. Opening reception May 1 during South First Fridays Art Walk. Exhibition runs May 1–29, 2026. Contact curator via DM or email for submission details. — Deadline: April 12, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: L'Image Satellite 2026 · Sept Off
item.description: Open call for photographers and visual artists working with contemporary still image practices including documentary, experimental, vernacular, and hybrid image forms. Selected artists exhibit at L'Image Satellite festival in Nice, September–October 2026. Artists receive €500 presentation fee, round-trip artwork transport, accommodation, and travel. Submit up to 20 JPEG images via online form and email. — Deadline: April 26, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: €500.

item.title: Rarefied Light 2026 · Alaska Photographic Center
item.description: Annual statewide juried exhibition with juror Nevada Wier (National Geographic, Smithsonian). Submit 1–20 images of any photographic form except AI-generated work. Selected work travels to galleries in Anchorage, Fairbanks, Juneau, and Cordova from October 2026. Includes three-day workshop (August 14–16) on color, light, action, and pattern in image-making. — Deadline: June 10, 2026. Fee: $30. Prize: $300.

item.title: Prix Mustaqbal 2026 — Momentum · Fondation TGCC
item.description: Annual competition promoting emerging contemporary creation. Open to artists aged 18–35, Moroccan or foreign residents in Morocco, working in drawing, painting, installation, photography, or sound art. No thematic constraints. Approximately 15 finalists exhibited at Artorium in Casablanca. Winner receives artist residency at Jardin Rouge and duo-shows in Paris and Casablanca. — Deadline: May 16, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: RBSA Summer Show 2026 · Royal Birmingham Society of Artists
item.description: Largest annual open exhibition at RBSA Gallery in Birmingham. All techniques and media welcome including photography and digital. Open to UK and international artists. £600 first prize, £300 second prize, plus highly commended certificates. — Deadline: May 5, 2026. Fee: £13. Prize: £600.

item.title: PN Awards 2026 — Book Prize & Project Grant · Photography Network
item.description: Annual book prize honoring innovation in photography scholarship, expression, and dissemination. Project grant supports emerging scholars, curators, and artists with funds to complete works in progress. — Deadline: June 15, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Denis Roussel Award 2026 · Rfotofolio
item.description: For photographers working with historical and alternative photographic processes including silver gelatin. Submit 7 images and statement. $2,000 main award plus merit awards. Portfolio review prize included. — Deadline: June 27, 2026. Fee: Donation-based (PWYC). Prize: $2,000.

item.title: Somewhere I Have Never Travelled — Group Exhibition · Art + Everywhere / Behind VA Shadows
item.description: Group exhibition exploring place as memory and memory as place. All mediums welcome including performance and installation. Exhibition runs July 12–September 12, 2026 in Harvard Square, Cambridge, MA. Artists responsible for shipping. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Schloss Plüschow Artist-in-Residence 2026 · Mecklenburg Artists' House
item.description: Five working scholarships for international visual artists. Three-month residency (October–December 2026) with €1,000/month stipend. On-site stay required at historic Schloss Plüschow in northern Germany. — Deadline: May 3, 2026. Fee: €10. Prize: €3,000.

item.title: MSU Zagreb Artist Residency 2026 · Museum of Contemporary Art Zagreb
item.description: One-month international artist residency (September 20 to October 20, 2026) within the Meeting Point project and L'Internationale's Museum of the Commons programme. Focus on climate crisis, shared resources, and the museum's relationship to local communities. Includes accommodation, €1,500 participation fee, up to €500 travel support, curatorial dialogue, and access to local community networks. Process-oriented, not production-focused. — Deadline: April 1, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: €1,500 + accommodation + travel.

item.title: On the Block - Street & Urban Photography · Lucie Foundation
item.description: Celebrates street and urban photography. Seeking unposed, unfiltered moments revealing quiet truths and vivid stories. — Deadline: March 31, 2026. Fee: $20/image. Prize: None listed.

item.title: The Narrative · TCG Gallery
item.description: International open call welcoming all forms of two-dimensional images, traditional and non-conventional media, and alternative photographic processes. Exhibition May 1 - June 1, 2026. — Deadline: April 20, 2026. Fee: Check website. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Whimsical · A Photographer's Place
item.description: Seeking work that surprises, delights, and transports viewers through playful storytelling, surreal elements, and unexpected juxtapositions. — Deadline: March 23, 2026. Fee: $35. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Fast Forward: Analog Photography as a Third Space · Los Angeles Center for Photography
item.description: Analog-only submissions exploring how photography creates space for camaraderie and interaction. Darkroom prints and experimental work welcome. — Deadline: March 24, 2026. Fee: $25–$200. Prize: None listed.

item.title: The Magic of Light - Photography Open Call · Art/Space 114
item.description: Film, digital, and alternative process photography including hybrid approaches. Exhibited in Los Angeles, CA. — Deadline: March 25, 2026. Fee: $45 for up to 5 images. Prize: None listed.

item.title: The Human Portrait · Photo Artfolio
item.description: Global online exhibit honoring portraiture in all its forms — documentary, fine art, street, conceptual, experimental, self-portraiture, and beyond. Seeking portraits that convey presence, emotion, tension, or quiet recognition. $20 for first image, $5 each additional, up to 20 images total. No AI-generated imagery. — Deadline: March 25, 2026. Fee: $20. Prize: $1,000.

item.title: BOTANICAL Photography Exhibit · Dusk Photo Gallery
item.description: Beyond documentation — seeking character in a leaf, architecture in a seedpod. All styles and processes welcome. Santa Fe, NM. — Deadline: March 26, 2026. Fee: $40–$45. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Photographic Exploration Project: ENTANGLEMENT · PEP Photography
item.description: Explores intricate webs of connections from intimate relationships to global systems. Group exhibition at Loop Raum in Berlin, July 2026. — Deadline: March 26, 2026. Fee: €5–€15. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Portfolio 2026 · Atlanta Photography Group
item.description: Juried exhibition featuring cohesive bodies of work. Juror: Natasha Egan (MoCP). Winner eligible for $4,000 High Museum purchase award. — Deadline: March 27, 2026. Fee: $75–$105. Prize: $4,000.
